name: Reflect breaks
doc: Reflect breaking (Cronos's OneShotReflect: the first spell it bounces ends it): the bounce flash's green dome shown whole on the reflector, then broken like glass - each of its polygons a shard flying out from the centre, spinning, falling and fading. Drawn as the game draws its Reflect / Shell / Protect bounce flash (0x570650: a battle model of the exe table 0xC81678 on the battle's resident texture page; each shard a one-polygon model made from it), so it loads no file, uploads no texture, uses no magic buffer and starts no camera: it plays while the bounced spell's effect runs. The game plays it through FujinEffects_PlayOnEntity (the battle's hit-effect queue); cast as a spell, it plays on each target (FujinEffects fxshatter.h).

copy.doc: A new effect: no exe function stands in for it.
